hook.name: SatoshiYield
hook.description: A hook for a project token/ETH pool that applies epoch-based swap fees via afterSwap delta returns. ETH-side fees are forwarded to a marketing wallet; token-side fees are split between the marketing wallet and a dead-address burn, with both the fee rate and the marketing/burn split decreasing across epochs. Trading is gated by a guardian-controlled enableTrading() call.
